removed.text: Line 3, שָׁלֹשׁ: the holam may be merged with the shin dot.
Line 16, הַלְלִי: I don't see a dagesh in the second lamed, but I'm not certain.
Line 18, לְהֻמָּם: the vowel under the he looks like qubuts but could be qamatz.
Line 10: the print has no period after וְעַד, only a wide space. I kept it as printed.
Line 17: the colon is printed inside the parenthesis, '(נ״א רֵעִים:)'. I kept it that way.
Line 1, אֶבְטַח: I read segol under the alef, which is how it looks in the enlarged band.
Metegs I didn't individually confirm: the ones in שָׁמַֽיִם, מִמַּֽעַל, קֶֽרֶן, חֶֽסֶד, שֶֽׁמֶשׁ, צֶֽדֶק, יָֽחַד.
וָרָֽמוּ: the vav looks like it has qamatz plus meteg, but sheva isn't ruled out.
I didn't individually confirm any of the metegs in this block.
